newsitem.title: USA: Saudi Arabia cuts U.S. Dec term crude 5-10 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia cuts U.S. Dec term crude 5-10 cts/bbl.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has cut term crude oil prices to U.S. customers by five to 10 cents a barrel for December, trade sources said Monday.
Arab Light was cut 10 cents a barrel to West Texas Intermediate minus $2.95 a barrel, and Arab Medium was cut five cents to WTI minus $3.80 a barrel.
The price for Extra Berri Light was dropped 10 cents a barrel to WTI minus $2.10 a barrel.
Arab Heavy, facing better demand elsewhere, was left unchanged at WTI minus $4.40 a barrel.
